decision: All 64 scenarios feasible. 10k scheduling stress uses 5 samples for every engine; fixed CPU work 64x200000 supports scaling. Cloud allowance 3x local estimate plus build/publication.

semantics.nift_cancel: No public future/thread cancellation API in frozen source; explicit cooperative atomic stop token required
semantics.nift_error: Recoverable future error arrives on await; successful sibling finishes; repeated await re-observes same error
semantics.worker_limits: Nift/JS/Go active concurrency never exceeds 1/2/4; Python distinct worker process count <= requested max_workers
